Local Official Detained in Minor Rape Case, Son on the Run

Munni Devi, the block chief of Kudu, has been taken into custody in connection with a case of alleged rape of a minor. Her son is reported to be absconding. The incident occurred in Lohardaga. There are also allegations that the accused threatened the victim's family.
